==Enshrined deities==
Its principal deities are {{ill|Sukunabikona|ca|Sukunabikona|fr|Sukunabikona|it|Sukuna-hikona|ja|スクナビコナ|ko|스쿠나비코나|mni|ꯁꯨꯀꯨꯅꯕꯤꯀꯣꯅ|pl|Sukunabikona|pt|Sukunahikona|simple|Sukunabikona|sv|Suku-Na-Bikona|zh|少彥名|qid=Q3275687|lt=Sukunahikone-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Takamimusubi|de|Takamimusubi|es|Takami-musubi-no-kami|fa|تاکامیموسوبی|fr|Takamimusubi|id|Takamimusubi|it|Takamimusubi|ja|タカミムスヒ|ko|다카미무스비|ks|تاکامِمُسُبی|pl|Takamimusubi|ru|Такамимусуби-но ками|zh|高皇產靈尊|qid=Q125400|lt=Takamimusubi-no-Mikoto}}, and {{ill|Shinatsuhiko|azb|شینات سوهیکو|es|Shinatsuhiko|fa|شینات سوهیکو|it|Shinatsuhiko|ja|シナツヒコ|mni|ꯁꯤꯅꯠꯁꯨꯍꯤꯀꯣ|ru|Синацухико-но ками|sv|Shinatsuhiko|zh|志那都比古神|qid=Q1073925|lt=Shinatobe-no-Mikoto}}. ''{{ill|Jinja Kakuroku|ja|神社覈録|qid=Q11590708}}'' and ''{{ill|Tokusen Jinmyōchō|ja|特選神名牒|qid=Q11571092}}'' state “deity unknown.”

==History==
The origin of foundation is unknown. Together with nearby {{ill|Amayukawata Shrine|ja|天湯川田神社|qid=Q63891125}} (Kashiwara Takaida 89), it is thought that the Tottori no Muraji, based in this area, enshrined their {{ill|Oyagami|fr|Oyagami|it|Oyagami|ja|祖神|simple|Oyagami|qid=Q85882782}}. In ''{{ill|Kujiki|ar|كجيكي|fa|کوجیکی (سندای کوجی هونگی)|fr|Kujiki|id|Kujiki|it|Kujiki|ja|先代旧事本紀|ko|선대구사본기|pt|Kujiki|ru|Кудзики|uk|Кудзікі|vi|Cựu sự kỷ|zh|先代舊事本紀|qid=Q2716751}}'' “Tenjin Hongi,” {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Sukuna-hikone-no-Mikoto}} is given as ancestral deity of Tottori no Muraji. It had been an {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=official shrine}} since the time of the {{ill|Kōnin-shiki|ja|弘仁式|zh|弘仁式|qid=Q17228444}}, and in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}} it is listed as “Sukunakawata Shrine, Ōagata District, Kawachi Province,” ranked as a small shrine.

In the medieval period it was called “Shirasaka Daimyōjin.” One theory says the place now occupied by {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ninomiya Shrine}} (Andō-chō 19-9, moved to current site in Taishō after merging two shrines) was “Aza Shirasaka,” and was the original site of Sukunakawata Shrine. For that reason Ninomiya Shrine is also treated as a candidate shrine, though Ninomiya Shrine itself does not claim Shikinaisha status.

In Meiji 5 ({{ill|1872|ab|1872|af|1872|als|1872|am|1872 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1872|ar|1872|ary|1872|arz|1872|ast|1872|avk|1872|az|1872|azb|۱۸۷۲ (میلادی)|ba|1872 йыл|ban|1872|bar|1872|bat_smg|1872|bcl|1872|be|1872|be_x_old|1872|bg|1872|bn|১৮৭২|bpy|মারি ১৮৭২|br|1872|bs|1872.|ca|1872|cdo|1872 nièng|ce|1872 шо|ceb|1872|ckb|١٨٧٢|co|1872|crh|1872|cs|1872|csb|1872|cv|1872|cy|1872|da|1872|de|1872|diq|1872|el|1872|eml|1872|eo|1872|es|1872|et|1872|eu|1872|fa|۱۸۷۲|fi|1872|fiu_vro|1872|fo|1872|fr|1872|frp|1872|frr|1872|fur|1872|fy|1872|ga|1872|gan|1872年|gcr|1872|gd|1872|gl|1872|gv|1872|he|1872|hi|१८७२|hif|1872|hr|1872.|hsb|1872|ht|1872 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1872|hy|1872|hyw|1872 թուական|ia|1872|id|1872|ilo|1872|io|1872|is|1872|it|1872|ja|1872年|jv|1872|ka|1872|kaa|1872|kk|1872 жыл|kn|೧೮೭೨|ko|1872년|krc|1872 джыл|ku|1872|kv|1872-ӧд во|la|1872|lb|1872|lez|1872 йис|li|1872|lij|1872|lmo|1872|lt|1872 m.|lv|1872. gads|mai|१८७२|map_bms|1872|mdf|1872|mg|1872|mhr|1872|mi|1872|min|1872|mk|1872|mr|इ.स. १८७२|mrj|1872 и|ms|1872|my|၁၈၇၂|myv|1872 ие|mzn|۱۸۷۲|nah|1872|nap|1872|nds|1872|nds_nl|1872|new|ई सं १८७२|nl|1872|nn|1872|no|1872|nrm|1872|nso|1872|oc|1872|olo|1872|or|୧୮୭୨|os|1872-æм аз|pa|1872|pam|1872|pap|1872|pl|1872|pnb|1872|pt|1872|qu|1872|ro|1872|ru|1872 год|rue|1872|sa|१८७२|sah|1872|scn|1872|sd|1872ع|se|1872|sh|1872.|shn|1872|si|1872|simple|1872|sk|1872|sl|1872|smn|1872|sq|1872|sr|1872|stq|1872|su|1872|sv|1872|sw|1872|szl|1872|ta|1872|te|1872|tet|1872|tg|Соли 1872|th|พ.ศ. 2415|tk|1872|tl|1872|tly|1872|tr|1872|tt|1872 ел|udm|1872 ар|uk|1872|ur|1872ء|uz|1872|vec|1872|vi|1872|vls|1872|vo|1872|wa|1872|war|1872|xmf|1872|yi|1872|za|1872 nienz|zea|1872|zh|1872年|zh_classical|一八七二年|zh_min_nan|1872 nî|zh_yue|1872年|qid=Q7753}}), it was ranked as village shrine and renamed from Shirasaka Myōjin to the current shrine name.
